_source: CAPRI Online Manual, Annex: Code lists, Tables 1-4 (capri-model.org/dokuwiki_help, last modified 2022-11-07, CC0 1.0). Table 3 is CAPRI's own 'Connection between CAPRI and REGIO crop areas, crop production and herd sizes'.
_purpose: The concordance between Eurostat REGIO collection categories and CAPRI activities. This is the mapping COCO/CAPREG applies (documentation section 2.4.8) and the piece that must exist before a base year can be built from public statistics rather than a CAPRI GDX. Previously recorded in this project as 'not available in accessible form' - that was wrong; it is public.
_how_capri_uses_it: REGIO carries only a few crop aggregates (cereals with wheat/barley/grain maize/rice; potatoes, sugar beet, oilseeds with rape and sunflower; tobacco, fodder maize; grassland; permanent crops with vineyards and olive plantations). CAPRI covers ~30 crop activities. The aggregates are broken down using NATIONAL SHARES of the aggregate - so a REGIO-derived regional file is share-allocated by construction, which is why 35% of base_areas_eurostat.csv carries repeating decimals.

this_models_activity_aliases._note: Where this model's codes differ from CAPRI's documented supply-model activity list (Annex Table 4).
this_models_activity_aliases.COTT+OFIB: TEXT (flax and hemp) - split differently here
this_models_activity_aliases.OFOD: approximately OFAR (other fodder on arable land)

activities_in_capri_absent_here.PARI: paddy rice - ~400 kha EU, concentrated in IT and ES
activities_in_capri_absent_here.TABO: table olives (distinct from OLIV, olives for oil)
activities_in_capri_absent_here.OWIN: other wine (distinct from TWIN, table wine)
